title: *Welcome to Hatfield Elite Academy*
body:
*Building confidence, intellectual growth and spiritual strength.*
*Forward Ever, Backwards Never!*

Welcome to the official website of *Hatfield Elite Academy* - A Rising Elite Star in Hatfield!

Located at *54 Glamis Road, Hatfield, Harare*, we are a premium independent school offering quality, values-based education from ECD to Advanced Level. At Hatfield Elite, we believe in nurturing the whole child - academically, morally and spiritually.

*Give us your child and we will give you results.*

WHY PARENTS ARE CHOOSING HATFIELD ELITE ACADEMY

- *Excellent Academic Standards:* We are results-driven with a strong pass rate culture.
- *Small Class Sizes:* Every child is seen, heard and taught individually.
- *Highly Qualified & Committed Teachers:* Passionate educators who go the extra mile.
- *Values-Based Education:* We instill discipline, respect, integrity and Godly character.
- *Personal Growth & Character:* We build leaders, not just learners.

2027 ENROLLMENT NOW OPEN!

*Registration for Form 1 and Lower 6th - January 2027 Intake is in progress.*

Limited places are available.

*For Lower 6th, we are offering:*

*ARTS:* English, History, Geography, Literature, Fine Art and more.
*COMMERCIALS:* Accounts, Business Studies, Economics, ICT and more.

Secure your child's place at the school that is shaping the future of Hatfield.

VISIT US TODAY

We invite you to visit our campus for a tour.

*Address:* 54 Glamis Road, Hatfield, Harare
*Call / WhatsApp:* +263 775 000 713

*Together, we build brighter futures.*

*Dr. Gallie Kawanzaruwa*
Director
